items.zh: 有些失败可以归咎于缺乏经验。
items.en: Some failures can be chalked up to a lack of experience.

items.zh: 试问40年不注意饮食会产生影响吗？
items.en: Who knew 40 years of neglect would have repercussions?

items.zh: 远处的草地上，银色的查尔斯河闪闪发光。
items.en: Far away in the meadow gleams the silver Charles.

items.zh: 李教授还说普林斯顿大学的图书馆深深地吸引了她。
items.en: Professor Li also says that Princeton's libraries captured her heart.

items.zh: 为使这款产品在竞争激烈的市场中脱颖而出，公司负责人建议把传统文化融入到产品的设计理念中。
items.en: To make the product stand out in the highly competitive market, the head of the company suggests integrating traditional culture into its design philosophy.
